rules.aggregate: Require every selected unit and valid count/denominator pair from the same year and level. Never average source percentages. IEP remains single-unit only.
rules.race: Four independently reported categories; not an exhaustive distribution. No remainder is inferred.
rules.history: Annual DESE demographic exports. Definitions and coverage may vary by year; these extracts alone do not establish invariant historical methodology. Source names may change for a stable identifier. Historical records can predate SLU sponsorship.
rules.period: Historical years end in 2025. Preliminary 2025-26 enrollment is never appended.
